subject: 新华路“新·境”口袋公园
address: 上海市长宁区新华路359号新华社区青年中心旁

observedClaims: The site is a 22-metre-long alleyway between two buildings on Xinhua Road.
The widest part is less than 4.2 metres.
The project area is 106 square metres.
The entrance is on Xinhua Road and the internal space is relatively far from the main road.
The project uses mirror-finished stainless steel, weathering steel and pebbledash stone.

coverage.observationDirection: from the Xinhua Road entrance toward the interior alley

observed: The park is a narrow alley site between two buildings.
The site is about 22 metres long and less than 4.2 metres at its widest point.
Mirrored side walls, a weathering-steel entrance/profile, rotating exhibition panels and a walkable path are visible.
OSM ways 864485662 and 864485663 expose facing edges around the address fallback corridor.
inferred: The facing edges of ways 864485662 and 864485663 are the two flanking building edges described by the design source.
The midpoint axis of those facing edges is the safest non-cadastral placement axis.
The southeast end of the axis is the Xinhua Road entrance end.
unknown: The cadastral parcel polygon and surveyed wall offsets.
The exact irregular width profile along the full 22 metres.
Exact mirror-wall, planting-island, bench and entrance-frame dimensions.
Whether OSM building eaves or facade offsets differ from the footprint edges.
